label: Pro 2.1.0
title: Watch your site and hand proof to an auditor
lede: Pro 2.1.0 turns the one-off scan into ongoing monitoring: only new findings fail a run, and a webhook tells your team. It also adds an evidence bundle that you can give to an auditor or a client.

items.title: Only new findings fail the build
items.text: Save the findings you already know as a baseline. From then on a scan only fails when something new appears, so old findings no longer block every deploy.
items.code:
# once: save today's findings as the baseline
npx witness-scan dist --write-baseline witness-baseline.json

# every build: only findings not in the baseline fail the run
npx witness-scan dist --baseline witness-baseline.json

items.title: A comparison for every pull request
items.text: Write a Markdown comparison with the baseline (new, fixed, unchanged) and post it as the pull request comment.

items.title: An alert when something new appears
items.text: Send a message to Slack, Mattermost, Discord or any JSON endpoint when a scan finds something new. Only https URLs are accepted.

items.title: An evidence bundle with a hash manifest
items.text: Collect the register, client report, public AI page, scan, change log and legal status in one folder with SHA-256 hashes. Verify later that nothing has changed. The bundle is not signed.
items.code:
npx witness-report evidence --out evidence/
npx witness-report evidence --verify evidence/

note: The demo runs in your browser and cannot run the CLI. Scanning, alerts and the evidence bundle need your own build output, CI or server.
